annotations.title: Check a trading record (MT4/MT5 report, statement or CSV)

description: Judges whether a finished trading record's results look real or like luck: reads the trades, applies a luck test that allows for the number of versions tried, checks costs, losing years and grid/martingale signs, and returns a verdict (REAL / PROMISING / LIKELY_LUCK / NO_EVIDENCE / FAIL / HIDDEN_RISK / TOO_FEW) with its reason. Use it for a record of trades already taken or backtested; for strategy code or written rules use test_strategy_code. Nothing is stored: the record is read as data, never run, and discarded after the answer.

filename.description: The file's name, e.g. ReportTester.html or trades.csv (helps read the format)
filename.title: Filename

is_forward.description: True if every trade in the record was taken after the strategy was fixed (a forward or live record)
is_forward.title: Is Forward

name.description: Optional name of the strategy or EA
name.title: Name

record_text.description: Text of an MT4 or MT5 Strategy Tester report (HTML), an MT4/MT5 account statement (HTML), a cTrader, NinjaTrader, TradingView ('List of trades') or Myfxbook CSV export, or any CSV of closed trades (close time + profit); under about 700 KB through this connector; for a bigger file, ask the user to upload it at https://truetest.uk/strategy and give you the assistant code shown with the result, then call get_record_check
record_text.title: Record Text

versions_tried.description: How many versions, settings or EAs were tried before this one, as stated by the user (it raises the luck bar)
versions_tried.title: Versions Tried

name: check_trading_record

Concentration.description: sales_blockers_a2 item 3: the judge's stored concentration (how much of the profit the best few trades made)

avg_without.description: the average result of all the other trades (left out when there are none)
avg_without.title: Avg Without

k.description: how many of the best trades are counted
k.title: K

share.description: the part of the total profit those best trades made (left out when the total is 0 or below)
share.title: Share

Concentration.title: Concentration

backtest_note.description: PROMISING only: it is a backtest
backtest_note.title: Backtest Note

does_not_show.description: what the verdict does not cover (shown together with shows)
does_not_show.title: Does Not Show

context.description: the points are true facts from the record and do not change the verdict
context.title: Context

points.description: up to 3 things the record does well, computed from its trades; they come after the verdict and never replace it
points.title: Points

warning.description: grid / martingale records: why the good-looking numbers are a known risk shape
warning.title: Warning

what_if.description: at most 1 what-if on the same trades (a smaller risk, a drawdown stop); hindsight, never a forecast
what_if.title: What If

what_if_note.description: the condition that belongs with the what-if
what_if_note.title: What If Note

scope.description: how the versions behind the luck bar were counted
scope.title: Scope

RecordRead.description:
upload-formats council 3 (11 Nov 2026, item 7): the same "what we read" block the website shows, so the assistant can check the
record is the user's before trusting the verdict. Nothing from the file's own text

currency.description: the account currency where the file states it (a 3-letter code), else ""; amounts are never converted
currency.title: Currency

date_order.description: day/month or month/day when the file's dates were slash or dot dates, else ""
date_order.title: Date Order

kind.description: the kind of record read ("" when not known)
kind.title: Kind

language.description: the MT5 report language read, else ""
language.title: Language

net.description: their total profit after costs, in the account currency
net.title: Net

net_check.description: the balance check of a translated MT5 report, else ""
net_check.title: Net Check

note.description: a fact about the record's costs (for example fees the export leaves out), else ""
note.title: Note

open_drop.description: the worst drop with open trades counted, beside the closed-trade drop, else ""
open_drop.title: Open Drop

parser.description: the reader version that read the record
parser.title: Parser

quality.description: how the tester made its prices, from the report's own header, else ""
quality.title: Quality

quality_caution.description: a warning when the tester made up most of the prices, else ""
quality_caution.title: Quality Caution

skipped.description: rows left out and why, with their line numbers; "" when none
skipped.title: Skipped

time_zone.description: the time zone the export states, else ""
time_zone.title: Time Zone

RecordRead.title: RecordRead

concentration.description: info only: how much of the profit the best few trades made (left out for results stored before 17 Nov 2026)

evidence_scope.description: what the verdict shows and what it does not show

good_points.description: what the record does well; it follows the verdict and its reason

read.description: what was read from the record (trades, net, dates, currency, rows left out)

t_day_clustered.description: left out when the record has no spread of results to measure
t_day_clustered.title: T Day Clustered

worst_day.description: info only: the largest daily loss, for scale (never a verdict input)
worst_day.title: Worst Day
